summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 4 new features: (1) Template Detail View - clicking template card shows all sections, framework coverage with individual control IDs, SIEM thresholds with best practices, Generate button works; (2) Document Library Enhancement - unified list shows both generated policies and uploaded documents, type filter (All/Generated/Uploaded), status filter (Draft/Under Review/Approved/Completed), search works across both types; (3) Approved Policy → Framework Linkage - backend creates mappings in mappings collection when policy approved, re-approval replaces old mappings; (4) Reviewer/Approver Assignment - Assign button opens dialog, lists org users with checkboxes for Reviewer/Approver roles, Save Assignments persists to backend, assignees shown in approval bar.
seed_data_creation: Used existing generated policies and org users from prior sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features fully implemented and tested. Template Detail View shows sections, frameworks with control IDs, SIEM thresholds. Document Library has type/status filters and unified list. Framework linkage creates mappings on approval. Assignee dialog works with org users. Key endpoints: GET /api/policy-templates (returns full template info), GET /api/policy-templates/org-users (returns org users), PUT /api/policy-templates/generated/{id}/assignees (assigns reviewers/approvers), PUT /api/policy-templates/generated/{id}/status (triggers framework linkage on approval).
